text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the fourth corner and into the 
homestretch!! All the Umamusume begin 
their final spurt!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(A chill like a frozen prison...! So this 
is the current Kris S's—)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(No, it's not just the chill...!! This 
weight, as if I'm being bound, is...!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I won't let you get away.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The chasers are desperately closing in!! 
But it's Symboli Kris S!! Symboli Kris S 
crosses the line to win!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"No need for the title of Kikuka-sho 
Umamusume!! Symboli Kris S wants the Tenno 
Sho shield! She has magnificently 
conquered the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
S-So strong~~!! Gimlet was so close too, 
what is up with this generation...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aren't those two basically the center of 
this whole era now?! That's seriously how 
good that race was!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ngh, t-this is way too insane...—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't even run against her, and 
yet... I'm this... terrified of Kris 
S-senpai...!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's so cold, I'm getting goosebumps... 
I've never felt like this before...â

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(There's no mistaking that weight. That... 
was the sensation of the chains of 
fate...!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...That was magnificent, Kris S. Is this 
your power now—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah. However...—I will become—even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: I have no intention—of settling here.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, now that is what I like to 
see...!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Become mercilessly, limitlessly 
stronger...! It is precisely because you 
are so absolute that—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I thirst for your destruction!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It begins here, Kris S. The prologue to 
our chronicle of war...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――... Very well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —In the next race.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... on to the "next."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...You sure taught me a lesson. But 
thanks to that, I understand it well now. 
The true nature of your power...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, you are—the center of the era. 
You are on the verge of becoming destiny 
itself...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Haha... Hahahaha...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaaa-hahahahaaaaa---!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Very well, O world. O natural order. If 
that is the path you choose— I shall 
incinerate it head-on!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days after the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—I-Is what they just announced really 
true...!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Can you truly not believe it that much? 
Then, I shall tell you once more—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I hereby declare that next year, I shall 
run in both the Yasuda Kinen and the 
Takarazuka Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: D-Did Trainer <username> decide on that rotation!?
choice_data_list: She and I decided on it together.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"Was the possibility of getting injured 
again even considered?!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Of course. Without hardship, there is no 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes fixed upon the path we 
shall tread. We shall deliver even greater 
"swiftness" and "might" to all observers.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"Huh!? Running Yasuda and Takarazuka 
back-to-back, for real!? She's gonna get 
injured again doing that!!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"‘No, Trainer, stop this. No matter how 
much Gimlet wants to do it, isn't this 
being a bit too irresponsible?’"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, if you ask whether I wanna see it 
or not, I do, but isn't that a bit too 
extreme?"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Social Media Platform
text_block_list.text:
"‘It kinda feels like they're hiding 
behind their Umamusume's feelings, which 
leaves a bad taste. I wish they'd explain 
a bit more~’"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Our senpais are taking a ton of flak.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Ain't she scared at all?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-senpai is crazy strong... I 
seriously can't even picture her losing...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I might get injured again at the 
Yasuda Kinen or Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Even with everyone saying... whatever 
they want about me like this...—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: "...I'm... terrified... Senpai—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until next year's Yasuda Kinen, time was 
slowly, yet significantly, beginning to 
move—
